title: Text pop scale curve
summary: Key-word pop curve (1.0 -> 1.12 -> 1.0 over 180 ms by default) as per-frame scales, an ffmpeg time expression and ASS transform tags, with ease and spring shapes.
examples: Pop the number '14 days' when it is spoken
Scale a drawtext caption word with a 180 ms pop

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
